reason: No usable photo: the only image of the society itself is its 200x200 logo, which the ingest's image check rejects; the channel avatar (UCjgWFKCwHqODgQQ51vj-N7Q, 6,810 subscribers, Data API 11 Nov 2026) is a default letter, and the site's other images are a donation flyer with an architect's rendering and stock pictures of the Holy Trio and Belur Math.
